import json,hashlib,os
root='/root/worktrees/send-c1b'
H=json.load(open(root+'/docs/implementation/c2a-r30/starting-hashes.json'))
if isinstance(H,dict) and 'files' in H: H=H['files']
print(type(H).__name__, len(H)); items=H.items() if isinstance(H,dict) else [(x['path'],x['sha256']) for x in H]
H=dict(items)
print('placement in snapshot', H.get('backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py','?')[:8])
tests=[k for k in H if k.startswith('backend/dealroom_sign/tests/')]
bad=[k for k in tests if not os.path.exists(root+'/'+k) or hashlib.sha256(open(root+'/'+k,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=H[k]]
print('snapshot test files', len(tests), 'changed/missing', bad)
new=[]
for dp,dn,fn in os.walk(root+'/backend/dealroom_sign/tests'):
    if '__pycache__' in dp: continue
    for f in fn:
        rel=os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dp,f),root)
        if rel not in H: new.append(rel)
print('new', len(new)); print(sorted(x for x in new if 'fixtures' not in x)); print(sorted({os.path.dirname(x) for x in new if 'fixtures' in x}))
other=[]
for k,v in H.items():
    if k.startswith('docs/'): continue
    p=root+'/'+k
    if not os.path.exists(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=v: other.append(k)
print('non-docs differing from snapshot', other)
